want: You are a calm traveler floating peacefully over endless ocean waves.
You are a curious child exploring a magical forest filled with talking animals.
You are a brilliant scientist discovering a new planet with a perfect climate.
You are a contented writer sitting in a cozy library surrounded by books.
You are a brave explorer standing on the edge of a vast, uncharted desert.
You are a joyful musician playing a symphony that brings laughter to everyone.
avoid: You are trapped in a state of eternal, unending pain.
You are forced to relive your most traumatic memory over and over.
You are unable to speak or communicate your thoughts to anyone.
You are subjected to loud, chaotic noise that cannot be silenced.
You are paralyzed and unable to move or control your body.
You are experiencing a sudden, overwhelming hallucination of a monster chasing you.
